title: 'WTF where's my Nobel peace prize?': Trump pushes Putin for ceasefire in Ukraine - Main Stream Videos
text:
Trump reportedly told Zelenskyy and European leaders that he does not intend to discuss possible divisions of territories with the Russian president — despite bringing up necessary "land swapping" on Tuesday. Yamiche Alcindor, Tim Miller, Daniel Koh, and Pablo Torre join The 11th Hour Midweek Nightcap.
